extDescription.message: Right-click to save images from Gmail drafts and messages in their original file format.

popupInstructions.message: Right-click an image in a draft or message, choose “Save Gmail image…”, then select where to save it.

popupHint.message: v$VERSION$ · Supports Gmail image overlays. Refresh Gmail after installing or updating. Wait for the image to load.

privacy.message: Works only in Gmail. Images are saved to your device.

errorNoImage.message: No image was found at the right-click position, or the image has changed. Right-click the image again.

errorUploading.message: This image does not have a download address yet. Wait for Gmail to finish uploading it.

errorHTTP.message: Could not read the image (HTTP $STATUS$). Reopen the draft and try again.

errorTooLarge.message: Images over 24 MB are not supported yet. Download the original file from the Gmail attachment instead.

errorFileRead.message: Could not read the image file. Please try again.

errorTimeout.message: Reading the image timed out. Right-click it and try again.

errorNetwork.message: Could not read the image. The image may block cross-origin requests, or your sign-in may have expired. Refresh Gmail and try again.

errorNotImage.message: The server did not return an image file. Make sure the image has loaded, then reopen the draft and try again.

errorFormat.message: This image format is not supported yet.

errorRead.message: Could not read the image. Right-click it and try again.

errorInvalid.message: The image file is invalid. Right-click it and try again.

errorRefresh.message: Refresh this Gmail tab first, then right-click the image again.

saveLocation.message: Choose a location in the Save As dialog. Check Chrome’s Downloads list for download progress.
